title: German Foreign Office to Bernstorff, 5 Dec 1916 (Arabia): cipher telegram forwarded by Grew, groups not kept (catalogue 635)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, 841.857/244, M580 reel 191 frame 0111 (placeholder only); FRUS 1916 Supplement doc. 424
documents.route: German Foreign Office, Berlin -> Count Bernstorff, Washington (via Grew, US Embassy Berlin, and the State Department)

plaintext.source: Grew's covering telegram 4691 says only that it concerns the Arabia and instructs Bernstorff to settle the matter by conversations in Washington; Bernstorff's letter to Lansing of 8 Dec 1916 (Lansing Papers I no. 547) paraphrases the instruction. The German text and its groups are in no digitised source.

transcription.source: None: the file copy reads '(Quote German cipher)'; FRUS prints no groups.

system.summary: A German diplomatic cipher telegram of unknown length; the groups were delivered to the Ambassador and not kept in the State Department file, so neither the code nor its figures are known.
system.notes: The catalogue guess (13040 / 0075) rests on the channel, not on any group.

prior_solution.where: None found; Bernstorff's letter of 8 Dec 1916 paraphrases the instruction (Lansing Papers I no. 547); a Room 40 decrypt may exist in TNA (not checked)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: the user posed the target by its catalogue page https://cyphersolver.com/solve/635.html; no target-specific intervention.
tools: Internet Archive full text of Bernstorff 1920

solution.what: Frame check of NARA M580-191-0111 (841.857/244): Grew 4691 with '(Quote German cipher)' and no groups (claude frame check 12, recorded in catalogue.json).
Viewed M580 reel 191 frames 0109-0113 (841.857/242-246) at 1400 px: 4692 in clear, 4691 placeholder, a Havre consular report, a YMCA letter. No German code groups on any sheet.
FRUS 1916 Supp. doc. 424 and Lansing Papers I no. 547 (Bernstorff to Lansing, 8 Dec 1916): the instruction is paraphrased, the cipher text is not printed.
Bernstorff, Deutschland und Amerika (1920), Internet Archive OCR searched for Arabia: only the 1915 Arabic case and a 1916-17 report; the telegram of 5 Dec 1916 is not printed.

Earlier sweeps for catalogue 657 (targets/bernstorff1917, section 10: M367 and M580 OCR for German code sheets) read: incoming ciphers left the Department; no sibling ciphertext online. Closed as attempted, open.

outcome.method_basis: The cipher groups were delivered to the Ambassador and never kept in the file; no ciphertext exists in any digitised source, so there is nothing to attack.

gaps.item: The cipher telegram of 5 Dec 1916, Foreign Office to Bernstorff (all of it)
gaps.detail: Not in the NARA file copy, FRUS or Bernstorff 1920; the German draft (PA AA) or a Room 40 decrypt (TNA HW 7 / ADM 137) would be the source.

outcome.notes: Catalogue 635, closed 6 Nov 2026 as attempted, open. Not a crib for catalogue 657 (targets/bernstorff1917).
